extracted.intended_audience: recording artists, record labels, producers, and Recording Academy screening committees preparing GRAMMY submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Screening and eligibility criteria for many GRAMMY Award categories across genres, specifying what recordings, albums, tracks, packaging and production work qualify and how entries should be judged. Used by submitters and screening committees to determine proper category placement and admissibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: No synthesized imitation of large jazz ensemble / large jazz vocal ensemble placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Electronic synthesizers used to imitate the sound of a large jazz ensemble are not eligible in the (jazz) Category. Large jazz vocal ensemble albums must be entered in Best Jazz Vocal Album.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not enter albums that rely on synthesized imitation of large jazz ensembles in jazz categories; large vocal ensemble recordings belong specifically in the Best Jazz Vocal Album category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Jazz Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin Jazz albums by ensembles of any size/orchestration (with added vocals or not), representing the blending of Jazz and improvisation with any Latin and Iberian‑American music, Brazilian, and Argentinian tango music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category is for recordings that blend jazz/improvisation with Latin/Iberian‑American/Brazilian/tango elements; both instrumental and vocal-inclusive albums may be entered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Alternative Jazz Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in Alternative Jazz albums by individuals, duos, groups/ensembles (large or small), with or without vocals. Alternative Jazz is defined as a genre‑blending, envelope‑pushing hybrid mixing jazz (improvisation, interaction, harmony, rhythm, arrangements, composition, and style) with other genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include blends with R&B, Hip‑Hop, Classical, Contemporary Improvisation, Experimental, Pop, Rap, Electronic/Dance, Spoken Word and contemporary production techniques/instrumentation; instrumental albums in well‑established Smooth Jazz style should instead be entered in Contemporary Instrumental Category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional Pop Vocal Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums consisting of a type and style of song/performance that cannot properly be intermingled with present forms of pop music, including new performances of songs from the Great American Songbook and classic popular music forms, and musical theatre songs that are independent of a unifying narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings eligible include contemporary pop songs performed in a traditional pop style (reference to composition, vocal styling, and instrumental arrangement), songs with theatrical qualities, benefit/tribute/concert/cabaret albums of such repertoire. Additional eligibility: albums must contain more than 75% newly recorded (previously unreleased) performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Instrumental Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Contemporary instrumental music embracing a variety of genres where album concept and production emphasize instrumental performance, arrangement and/or melodic content and contain contemporary stylistic elements that set it apart from well‑established instrumental styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category is instrumental only; focus on instrumental emphasis, production and contemporary stylistic identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Musical Theater Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: For recordings of the score of a musical theater work created to support an underlying dramatic intention or theme; honors excellence in performances and production of musical theater recordings. Elements of the corresponding stage production should not be considered in evaluating the recording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of revues that reflect a dramatic theme are eligible; eligible entries must support an underlying dramatic intention/theme. Benefit/tribute concerts with various show songs and recordings of concert tours are not eligible. Non‑musical theater performance albums are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Solo Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in recordings of country music performances by solo artists (with or without band accompaniment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For singles/tracks; applies to solo artists only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Duo/Group Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes country music recordings, vocal or instrumental, that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility reflecting the broad spectrum of country music style and culture, balancing legacy and contemporary boundary‑pushing relevance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group‑billed recordings are eligible even when vocal feature only one member; eligibility determined by the group/collaborative performance as a whole rather than presence of a lead vocal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Song — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Songwriter’s award recognizing country music recordings (vocal and instrumental) that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation reflecting the broad spectrum of country music style and culture, honoring songs that remain reminiscent of legacy while engaging contemporary forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Song entries relate to songwriting excellence in the country idiom; treat as songwriter award (not performance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: For albums containing 75% new recordings and 51% country; recognizes country music recordings (vocal and instrumental) that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation reflecting the broad spectrum of country music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums must meet the stated percentages to be eligible (>=75% newly recorded; >=51% country content).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best American Roots Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in American Roots Music performance; the category encompasses subgenres of the American Roots Field (bluegrass, blues, folk, and regional roots music).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For singles/tracks, vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Americana Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in performances of Americana music: contemporary music incorporating elements of American roots music and vocal styles (country, roots‑rock, folk, bluegrass, R&B, blues) producing a distinctive roots‑oriented sound separate from pure source genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acoustic instruments are often present but Americana may use full electric band; category is for singles/tracks, vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best American Roots Song — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Songwriter’s award recognizing excellence in songwriting in subgenres encompassed in the American Roots Music Field, including Americana, bluegrass, blues, folk, or regional roots music. Instrumentals are not eligible; a song must comprise music and lyrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For songwriting submissions only; lyrics required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Americana Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of Americana music: contemporary music that incorporates elements of various American roots music and vocal styles to create a distinctive roots‑oriented sound separate from pure source genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums may include acoustic or electric instrumentation; applies to album submissions (vocal or instrumental).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Bluegrass Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in bluegrass recordings performed in vocal or instrumental styles that utilize bluegrass acoustic instrumentation (fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin, bass, Dobro) and singing style with production and sensibilities distinct from a pop approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instrumentation and traditional bluegrass sensibilities are central to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional Blues Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of traditional blues recordings, including those with traditional blues song structures, harmonic structures and rhythms, employing traditional blues instruments and including subgenres such as Delta, Piedmont, jump/swing, Chicago, and classic/Southern soul.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Traditional forms, instruments, and structures are defining; vocal or instrumental accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Blues Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in contemporary blues recordings: blues that vary from traditional song and harmonic structures and may employ non‑traditional rhythms (funk, hip‑hop, reggae, rock) and instruments plus contemporary production techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows broader stylistic variation and modern production choices compared to Traditional Blues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Folk Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in folk recordings in modern and/or traditional vocal and instrumental styles, as well as original material by artists who utilize traditional and/or modern folk elements; folk music is primarily but not exclusively acoustic with production and sensibilities distinct from a pop approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both traditional and modern folk elements qualify; instrumental or vocal albums accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Regional Roots Music Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes recordings of regional roots styles (Cajun, Hawaiian, Native American, Second Line brass band, polka, zydeco, go‑go, swamp pop, Conjunto, etc.) with production and sensibilities distinct from a pop approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Native American music defined as recordings that contain traditional/contemporary Native American elements in composition/arrangement. For Hawaiian music, Hawaiian language must be used in greater than 50% of vocal tracks and eligibility will be determined by the Screening Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Gospel Performance/Song — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if the song is new) of a traditional Christian, roots gospel or contemporary gospel recording. (Vocal only.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For singles/tracks; vocal performances only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Christian Music Performance/Song — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if the song is new) of a contemporary Christian pop, rap/hip‑hop, Latin, or rock music recording. (Vocal only.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For singles/tracks; vocal performances only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Gospel Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional or contemporary/R&B gospel music recordings. (Vocal only.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. For choir/chorus albums recognition goes to the choir/choral director at Academy discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Christian Music Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of Contemporary Christian Music, including pop, rap/hip‑hop, Latin, and rock. (Vocal only.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Roots Gospel Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional/roots gospel music including country, Southern gospel, bluegrass, and Americana. (Vocal only.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Pop Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility reflecting Latin pop and urban music styles and culture; includes balladeers and commercial Latin music and is not limited to any one region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics >50% in Spanish or music content primarily Latin in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Urbana Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Encompasses music greater than 50% Spanish lyrics originating in reggaeton and other Latin urban styles including rap, house, R&B, trap, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is driven by lyrical language share (>50% Spanish) and urban Latin stylistic origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Rock or Alternative Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin rock or alternative music recordings that create a sensibility reflecting the broad spectrum of Latin music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics >50% in Spanish or music content primarily Latin in style (excluding Brazilian) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Mexicana Album (Including Tejano) — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in recordings of Música Mexicana (banda, norteño, corridos, gruperos, mariachi, rancheros, sierreño, jarocho, huasteco, huapango) and Tejano music; eligible albums utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation reflecting Música Mexicana and Tejano styles/cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics >50% in Spanish or music content primarily of a traditional Mexican music genre in style are eligible. Musical style, not performer ethnicity, determines eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Tropical Latin Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in tropical Latin music recordings including salsa, merengue, vallenato, cumbia, bachata and other traditional/contemporary tropical styles, where albums utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect tropical Latin style/culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics >50% in Spanish or music content primarily Latin in style (excluding Brazilian) are eligible. Category houses all tropical genres, not limited to historically rooted idioms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Global Music Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Intended for vocal and instrumental performances with strong elements of global cultural significance that blend pop, R&B, dance, rap, folk with unique local expressions and techniques from the global diaspora outside the U.S., producing a unique sense of melody, rhythm, harmony, and lyric of global appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on performances that display global cultural significance and blending; for singles/tracks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best African Music Performance — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible recordings include vocal and instrumental performances with strong elements of African cultural significance that blend stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical representation found in Africa and the African Diaspora.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category focuses on African & African Diaspora elements; applicable to singles/tracks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Global Music Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of global music that incorporate global music elements uniquely found beyond traditional U.S. conventions or styles, including unique local expressions from across the globe; focuses on the excellence and quality of the recordings and performances themselves, independent of a particular genre or style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums of reggae, Latin or European pop are not eligible in this Category and should be entered in other appropriate categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Reggae Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of reggae music, including roots reggae, dancehall and ska.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For albums; vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best New Age, Ambient or Chant Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Category may incorporate elements/influences from diverse musical genres to serve artistic/functional uses such as: creating textural atmospheric journeys, forming soundscapes for relaxation/meditation/focus, fostering wellness/inner/spiritual awakening, or making devotional offerings. Recordings may include sacred and secular components and may originate/adapt from global sacred traditions or universal intent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Music may be improvisational/exploratory emphasizing texture/space, or structurally composed; may be consonant/dissonant, contemplative, dynamic or avant‑garde. Vocal music, solo or multi‑instrumentals, acoustic/synthesized/environmental sounds welcome. Category includes environmental recordings (recordist considered the artist).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Children's Music Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in children’s music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility reflecting the broad spectrum of children’s music; must be created and intended specifically for children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lyrics and English language translations are required with submissions. Children defined as infant to twelve years old. All children’s music recordings belong in this Category regardless of stylistic roots. Instrumental albums must show stylistic intention/content targeted to children. Children’s spoken word albums are eligible in Spoken Word Poetry Album and Best Audio Book, Narration, and Storytelling Recording. Soundtracks of children’s movies are eligible in Best Compilation Soundtrack For Visual Media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Comedy Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in comedy recordings including spoken word stand‑up comedy and musical/novelty recordings. New comedy performance albums, studio or live, audio only or as part of a video project, are eligible. Compilations/excerpts from a current year radio or television program, or new recordings first aired on television within five years of release date, are also eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ineligible: compilations/excerpts from non‑current year broadcast radio/TV programs, audio books (even if humorous), albums of sound effects, and albums of environmental recordings. Choose the appropriate category for ineligible content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Audio Book, Narration and Storytelling Recording — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in spoken work albums (excluding Spoken Word Poetry): audio books, storytelling, non‑musical drama, sermons, narrations with or without musical collaboration, and instructional recordings are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If recording has musical accompaniment but is primarily spoken, the narrator is eligible while musical accompanists may be credited parenthetically. Incidental talk/conversation in a studio used as accent to a musical recording does not constitute a spoken work. Compilations/excerpts of previously broadcast radio/TV, albums of sound effects, and environmental recordings are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Compilation Soundtrack for Visual Media — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in soundtrack compilation albums comprised predominantly of song or non‑original instrumental compositions created specifically for or as a companion to a current legitimate motion picture, television show/series, video game, or other visual media production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums must be >50% song compilation and may include previously released material. At least two‑thirds of musical tracks must have been used in the visual media. For documentaries/biopics/mixed works, eligible soundtrack must contain 50% or more newly recorded music; category placement determined by predominant nature of newly recorded music (song vs score). For television soundtracks, >50% of playing time must be from new episodes airing during the GRAMMY eligibility year. Configurations not available as stand‑alone audio streams/releases (e.g., some DVDs/video games) are not eligible. For releases tied to visual media with different release years, submitters have timing options (enter elsewhere in current year or wait and enter in visual media field next year under conditions described).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Score Soundtrack for Visual Media — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original score created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current legitimate motion picture, television show/series or other visual media. At least two‑thirds of the musical tracks must have been been used in the media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For television soundtracks, >50% of music must be from new episodes/programming in the GRAMMY eligibility year. Eligible orchestrations may include vocal coloring (not songs). Soundtracks of live concert films, live/filmed stage shows, musical/variety television shows, and musical documentaries focused on live performance are not eligible. Timing options for releases tied to media releasing in another eligibility year are provided (same as compilation soundtrack rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Score Soundtrack for Video Games and Other Interactive Media — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original scores created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current video game or other interactive media released within the qualification period. At least two‑thirds of the musical tracks for the album must have been used in the shipped game product (in‑game, live action play or cinematics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Album releases adhere to timing guidelines used in Music For Visual Media Field. Eligible scores may include vocal coloring (not songs). >50% of music on an otherwise eligible video game or interactive media soundtrack must be derived from new episodes/programming released during the GRAMMY eligibility year (applies to DLC and seasonal expansions as well as brand new content). Timing options for albums whose media release falls in the following eligibility year are available (same as other visual media categories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Song Written for Visual Media — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Songwriter’s award recognizing excellence in songwriting (melody and lyrics) written specifically for and used in a motion picture, television show/series, video game, or other visual media. The film version may be entered even if different from the version entered in other Categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing options for songs/albums tied to visual media with differing release years are the same as in other Music For Visual Media categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Music Video — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in music videos released online during the current eligibility year that are synchronous or predominantly synchronous to a commercially released recording and are recognized by the artist/record label as the official video for an individual track.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrant must provide a streaming link (YouTube or Vimeo) that remains active through the final voting period. Fan videos or re‑edits not recognized as official are ineligible. Multitrack videos or visual albums are not eligible (those belong in Best Music Film). Individual videos taken from previously eligible video album packages are not eligible. A GRAMMY nomination in a performance category does not affect eligibility of an eligible music video in following years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Music Film — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in concert/performance films or music documentaries released for sale to the public for the first time or first appearing on television/online during the current eligibility year; includes music‑focused individual music videos packaged into a cohesive visual album.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dramatic feature films and biopics are not eligible, but films with fictional elements are eligible. Episodes from television/online series, award shows, music competition shows, fictional music films, and musical biopics are not eligible, nor are re‑edited/repackaged programs older than five years or compilations of previously eligible clips. Adding bonus material to an otherwise ineligible film does not make it eligible. Entrants must provide active streaming links or physical media. A GRAMMY nomination does not affect eligibility of an eligible music film in following years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Recording Package — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in art and packaging for albums or singles released in a standard physical format; physical product released for the first time during the eligibility year is eligible provided the packaging is predominantly new.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements judged include package design, photography/graphic art of the entire package and any materials included. Previously released album art/packaging or reissues with only minimal new design elements are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Boxed or Special or Limited‑Edition Package — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in art and packaging for new special‑edition, limited‑edition, or boxed‑set packages in any configuration released for the first time during the eligibility year; elements judged include package design, photography/graphic art of the entire package and materials included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Packaging must be predominantly new; reissues with minimal new design elements are not eligible. Limited and special package releases must still meet the general distribution requirements to be eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Album Notes — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in album notes writing. Entries must be one piece of original writing written for a specific album and released as part of that album for the first time during the eligibility year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible notes must be of literary excellence, originality and communicativeness and provide relevant exposition of recorded content. Each entry must be predominantly original writing. Books or booklets written for an album that are simultaneously released separately do qualify. Notes taken from previously issued books, articles or reviews, testimonials, transcripts of prior interviews not specifically created for the current release, brief letters of praise or congratulations are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Historical Album — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in newly created albums in any genre that feature historically significant material with new annotation and new packaging that provide important contributions to a fresh historical perspective on the circumstances of the recording in program content and technology and, where relevant, quality remastering and/or audio restoration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entries may include previously released recordings, alternate takes and/or previously unreleased recordings in any combination, as well as old film soundtracks, cast show albums and radio broadcasts. Straight reissues with no restoration/remastering and no changes in track sequence or packaging are not eligible. Variant forms of previously GRAMMY‑entered material are not eligible. This Category is not for new recordings of a historic nature or newly recorded re‑creations; those should be entered in appropriate genre categories. Up to three compilation producers can be entered per album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Engineered Album, Non‑Classical — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in engineering on newly recorded non‑classical albums released for the first time during the eligibility year. All eligible credited recording engineers, mixers/mixing engineers and mastering engineers on the album are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic criterion: the finished commercial release (the album) is the object of judging. Consider overall mix, any unique techniques, quality of sound, and trueness of reproduction. Factors such as overdubbing, number of tracks, or recording site/mode are secondary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Engineered Album, Classical — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in engineering on newly recorded classical albums released for the first time during the eligibility year. All eligible credited engineers on the album are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judgment should be based on the finished commercial recording. Consider overall mix, unique techniques, quality of sound, and trueness of reproduction. Other factors (overdubbing, number of tracks, site or mode of recordings) are secondary. Appraisals should be made on the basis of the total album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Producer of the Year, Classical — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in production of classical audio recordings for a producer whose body of work released for the first time during the eligibility year represents consistently outstanding creativity in recording production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award is for a body of work (multiple releases) demonstrating outstanding and creative production in classical recordings during the eligibility year.
